metadata.scenario: A client contacts the office to set up an appointment for the following month at a convenient time. Category: Appointment Scheduling. Outcome: appointment_booked.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, this is Eleanor Watson. I’d like to set up an appointment for next month, please. Of course, Eleanor! Just to confirm, you’re looking for skilled nursing and physical therapy, right? Yes, that’s correct. My daughter usually coordinates everything, but I want to make sure we get the time right. Absolutely, I understand. What days in particular work best for you and your daughter? We prefer between 10 AM and 2 PM, ideally on Tuesdays or Thursdays. Perfect! How about I look at some time slots for Tuesday, February 6th? That sounds good. We have openings at 10 AM and 1 PM. Which time would you prefer? Let’s go with 10 AM if that works. Great! I have you scheduled for February 6th at 10 AM for skilled nursing and physical therapy. Thank you! Is there anything else I need to know before then? Just a reminder that your daughter should confirm the appointment a day before, in case there are any changes. Sure, I’ll let her know. Also, can I add some companion care for my mom on the weekends? Yes, we can definitely arrange that. Would you like it to be weekly? Yes, that would be ideal. Alright, I can set that up. What day would be best for the companion care? Saturdays, around the same time, if possible. Absolutely! I’ll note that down. Thank you, Margaret. I appreciate your help with this. You’re very welcome, Eleanor! I’ll finalize the appointment for February 6th at 10 AM and the Saturday companion care. Sounds good. Just to confirm, how much will the companion care cost? The companion care is priced at $25 to $30 per hour. Okay, that’s reasonable. Great! I'll follow up with your daughter about these arrangements. Thank you, Margaret. I’ll wait for the confirmation. You’re welcome! Have a great day, Eleanor! You too! Goodbye! Goodbye!
